subject: Billing cutover for AtlasGrid → Greenline Holdings: remit, VAT, and invoice reissue
messages:
From: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@atlasgrid.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-18T08:15:00-04:00
Subject: Billing: new payable address + VAT status after Greenline acquisition

Hi Jonas,

Quick note from our side as the AtlasGrid acquisition by Greenline closed last week. We need Redwood to start invoicing and routing payments to the acquiring entity as of today. Action items: 

- Please update the payable name to: Greenline Holdings Ltd (formerly AtlasGrid)
- New billing address: Greenline Holdings Ltd, Accounts Payable, 12 Riverfront Way, Dublin, D02 4YZ, Ireland
- EU VAT: Greenline will be handling VAT via reverse-charge. Our VAT ID (Greenline): IE3456789W. Please indicate "reverse charge - customer liable for VAT" on EU invoices.
- New billing contact: finance@greenline.com (cc'd to Tim Baker)
- Outstanding invoice INV-20270831 should be reissued in the new entity name or credited and re-billed — please advise next steps.

I've attached the signed PO that references Redwood services (AtlasGrid-PO-202709.pdf). Let me know what you need from legal/finance to action the ledger update.

Thanks,
Marta Lopez
CFO, AtlasGrid (now part of Greenline Holdings)
Attachments: AtlasGrid-PO-202709.pdf
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@atlasgrid.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-18T10:02:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Billing: new payable address + VAT status after Greenline acquisition

Thanks Marta — congrats on closing.

We can execute the billing cutover but will need a few items to process correctly:

1) Legal entity exact name and registered tax ID (for our ledger and invoice footer) — you noted IE3456789W; please confirm the full legal name as it appears on tax docs.
2) A copy of the acquisition certification or an authorizing letter on Greenline letterhead that confirms the payee change (so our billing ops team has an audit trail).
3) Bank beneficiary details if the payee has changed bank accounts (or confirm that payments should continue to the existing bank).

Naomi (cc) will own the ledger change and reissue/credit. If you can send the acquisition cert and any bank verification, we can: 
- Issue a credit for INV-20270831 and reissue it to Greenline with the reverse-charge note, or
- Reissue directly if you prefer no credit.

Estimated timeline: once we have documents, credit/reissue within 3 business days.

-Jonas
Jonas Weber
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
From: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@atlasgrid.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Tim Baker <tim.baker@greenline.com>
Date: 2027-09-19T09:30:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Billing: new payable address + VAT status after Greenline acquisition

Hi Naomi / Jonas,

Attached is the acquisition certificate and authorization (Greenline-Acquisition-Cert.pdf). Confirming the legal name to use on invoices is exactly: "Greenline Holdings Limited" and VAT ID IE3456789W.

Banking: Greenline will continue to use the same bank for outgoing wires, but payments should be made to the new payee name. Beneficiary contact at CityBank: payments@citybank.com (we can provide a bank letter if required).

For INV-20270831 we prefer a credit and then a reissued invoice to the Greenline entity so our AP can match the change.

Thanks — sending the signed change authorizations now.

Best,
Marta
Attachments: Greenline-Acquisition-Cert.pdf
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@atlasgrid.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-19T12:45:00-04:00
Subject: RE: Billing: new payable address + VAT status after Greenline acquisition

Hi Marta — thanks for the doc.

We have everything we need to start, but for compliance please can you also provide: 
- A PDF of Greenline's VAT registration certificate (we need to store it with the vendor record)
- Confirmation whether the VAT reverse-charge applies for all future EU invoices or only specific ones.
- Optional: a bank verification letter if the beneficiary account changed.

Attached is a short Bank Verification template that speeds approvals (Bank-Verification-Template.pdf).

Next steps from Redwood:
- Marcus (cc) will approve the credit and new invoice flow.
- We will create a new vendor record "Greenline Holdings Limited" and tag the old vendor record as "payee moved (2027-09-18)" for audit.
- Credit for INV-20270831 to be issued and a new invoice reissued with the reverse-charge footer: "Reverse-charge: VAT to be accounted for by the customer under Article 194 of Council Directive 2006/112/EC."

ETA: credit + reissue within 3 business days after receipt of VAT cert / signed authorization.

Naomi Feldman
Billing Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
Attachments: Bank-Verification-Template.pdf
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@atlasgrid.com>
Date: 2027-09-20T16:10:00-04:00
Subject: Fwd: Billing: new payable address + VAT status after Greenline acquisition

Marcus — can you sign off on the credit+reissue for INV-20270831? Client requested credit then new invoice under Greenline Holdings Limited (VAT IE3456789W) with reverse-charge note.

I've attached a stub of the credit/invoice we plan to post (INV-20270831-CREDIT-STUB.pdf). Let me know if we should just reissue in-place or process a credit and re-bill. Naomi has the acquisition cert and VAT cert pending (she asked for VAT cert which Marta is pulling).

If approved I'll coordinate the DocuSign envelope for the payee change authorization and the HubSpot deal will be updated (DEAL-8341).

Thanks,
Jonas
From: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@atlasgrid.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Tim Baker <tim.baker@greenline.com>
Date: 2027-09-21T09:00:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Billing: new payable address + VAT status after Greenline acquisition

Thanks — confirmed.

We completed the VAT cert extract and the signed change authorization (Signed-Change-Authorization.pdf). CityBank confirmed beneficiary name change is on file; wire instructions remain unchanged.

Please proceed with credit and reissue. For PO matching, please reference the original PO number in the new invoice footer. We will route payments from finance@greenline.com once the new invoice is posted.

Marta
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@atlasgrid.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-21T09:37:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Billing cutover for AtlasGrid → Greenline Holdings: remit, VAT, and invoice reissue

All — confirmed. Summary of agreed actions: 

1) Redwood billing ops will create vendor record: Greenline Holdings Limited (VAT IE3456789W).
2) Issue a credit for INV-20270831 and reissue INV-20270901 to Greenline with note: "Reverse-charge: VAT to be accounted for by the customer under Article 194 of Council Directive 2006/112/EC."
3) Attach original PO reference on the new invoice for AP matching.
4) Credit + new invoice to be posted within 3 business days.
5) Billing contact updated to finance@greenline.com and payable address as provided.

I've opened a DocuSign envelope for the payee change (https://docusign.net/ENVELOPE12345) and updated the HubSpot deal (https://redwood.app/hubspot/record/8341). Naomi — please upload the VAT cert to the shared drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0Bxyz.

Thanks everyone — I'll follow up when the credit and reissue are posted.

Jonas Weber
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
